body:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 800,000/mwezi:
Band 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Band 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
Band 3 (20%): TZS 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000
Band 4 (25%): TZS 40,000 × 25% = TZS 10,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 78,000/mwezi
TZS 40,000 ya ziada juu ya TZS 760,000 iko Band 4 (25%) = TZS 10,000.
guards_against: guards_against: band restatement tail — eval_191, a deliberately-protected row

body: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 800,000, PAYE = TZS 68,000 + 25% × (TZS 800,000 − TZS 760,000) = TZS 78,000. Mshahara halisi baada ya PAYE = TZS 800,000 − TZS 78,000 = TZS 722,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
guards_against: guards_against: net-pay tail — eval_395, a deliberately-protected row

body: Mfano halisi wa PAYE kwa TZS 800,000/mwezi: Band 1 (0–270,000): TZS 0. Band 2 (270,001–520,000): 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000. Band 3 (520,001–760,000): 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000. Band 4 (760,001–800,000): 40,000 × 25% = TZS 10,000. Jumla kabla ya punguzo = TZS 78,000. Punguzo la kibinafsi = TZS 26,000. PAYE inayolipwa = TZS 78,000 − TZS 26,000 = TZS 52,000.
guards_against: the live defect verbatim — 78,000 passed through on the way to 52,000
